reasoning: The icon shows a simple circular gauge or speedometer with a diagonal slash through it, representing 'speed/cruise control off', 'no speed limit / unthrottled', or a broken gauge. Because the slash obscures the left side of the dial, it is hard to read at small sizes and easily confused with a crossed-out clock or timer, making it useful only for a narrow set of vehicle gauge or network-throttling tasks.
